target_gates.description: The adult upper torso, central waist-abdomen, and pelvis remain readable in width and depth.
The central waist-abdomen zone visibly forms the torso maximum rather than a local garment bulge.
Contours taper coherently both upward toward the upper torso and downward toward the pelvis.
Rounded oval volume, a diamond motif, posture, lens distortion, or health inference alone does not substitute.
